name: Koishikawa Yuuma
source:
[b]Guitarist & Vocalist of [i]gem of rubble[/i][/b]

Blood-related elder brother of [url=/c153627]Koishikawa Miku[/url], and twin younger brother of [url=/c153705]Koishikawa Suguru[/url].
The middle child of Koishikawa siblings. Full of energy and tends to go with the flow.
Often ended up in fights with Miku.

[Translated from [url=https://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/lllj/index.html#subchara]official website[/url]]
